title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Timer T3565
entities.description: Timer used for NOTIFICATION message retransmission. Expiry triggers retransmission or procedure abortion after fifth expiry.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: Message retransmitted by network upon T3565 expiry.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message received from UE that triggers de-registration procedure collision handling.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message that could be received instead of DEREGISTRATION REQUEST in collision case.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message that could be received instead of DEREGISTRATION REQUEST in collision case.

entities.name: Paging procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by AMF over 3GPP access when UE is unreachable.

entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed by AMF when de-registration collision occurs.

entities.name: UE unreachable condition
entities.description: Condition where AMF determines UE is unreachable after fifth T3565 expiry.

entities.name: De-registration procedure collision condition
entities.description: Condition where network receives DEREGISTRATION REQUEST before SERVICE REQUEST or REGISTRATION REQUEST.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: State that AMF may enter over 3GPP access when UE is unreachable.

relations.description: Timer T3565 is started when NOTIFICATION message is transmitted.
Timer T3565 is reset and started again upon first expiry for NOTIFICATION message retransmission.
UE unreachable condition may trigger paging procedure execution.
UE unreachable condition may cause AMF to enter 5GMM-IDLE mode.
De-registration collision condition causes AMF to stop timer T3565.
De-registration collision condition triggers de-registration procedure execution.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message guards the de-registration collision condition.
